summary: User-side WeChat auth is H5/WEB OAuth (authorize → callback/complete) plus local mock `/api/v1/auth/dev-login`. Session is Sa-Token via custom `StpUserKit` (cookie-only, no header). Identity/invite reuse point is `UserIdentityPort.findOrRegister(WeChatIdentity, inviteCode, sponsorClaimSecretHash)` implemented by `MyBatisIdentityAdapter`. No miniprogram/code2session exists yet; adding `POST /api/v1/auth/wechat/miniprogram/login` should exchange `js_code` → openid/unionid, build a `WeChatIdentity` (new provider e.g. `WECHAT_MP`), then reuse findOrRegister + `establishSession`. Cookie-only token policy is the main design constraint for mini programs.

facts: AuthController base: /api/v1/auth; WeChat under /api/v1/auth/wechat/*; mock is /api/v1/auth/dev-login (not under wechat).

POST /api/v1/auth/wechat/authorize body BeginRequest{scene@NotBlank, inviteCode?, sponsorClaimSecret?, redirectUri@NotBlank} → ApiResponse<StartResult{authorizationUrl,state,expiresInSeconds}> + Set-Cookie market-shop-oauth-binding (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, path=/api/v1/auth/wechat, 5min).
GET /api/v1/auth/wechat/callback?code&state (+ cookie binding) → 302 Location storefrontOrigin+redirectUri?wechatLogin=success; establishes Sa-Token session.
POST /api/v1/auth/wechat/complete body CompleteRequest{code@NotBlank,state@NotBlank} + cookie → ApiResponse<SessionView{publicId,nickname,newlyRegistered}>.
POST /api/v1/auth/dev-login body DevLoginRequest{openId@NotBlank,nickname?,inviteCode?} → SessionView; gated by market-shop.wechat.mock-enabled.
GET /api/v1/auth/me → {userId,publicId,nickname}; POST /api/v1/auth/logout.
ApiResponse envelope: {success,code,message,data,timestamp}.
Application port AuthUseCase: StartResult begin(BeginCommand); LoginResult complete(CompleteCommand); LoginResult devLogin(DevLoginCommand).
AuthApplicationService implements AuthUseCase; scenes only H5|WEB; STATE_TTL=5m; complete uses WeChatOAuthPort.exchange then UserIdentityPort.findOrRegister.
WeChatOAuthPort: String authorizationUrl(scene,state,callbackUri); WeChatIdentity exchange(scene,code).
WeChatOAuthAdapter.exchange uses sns/oauth2/access_token + sns/userinfo; provider stored as WECHAT_+scene (WECHAT_H5/WECHAT_WEB).
devLogin builds WeChatIdentity(provider=WECHAT_MOCK, appId=local, openId, unionId=mock-union-+openId, nickname default 微信演示用户).
Session issue in AuthController.establishSession: StpUserKit.logic().login(userId); token-session sets publicId,nickname,authEpoch; response has no token fields.

StpUserKit (actual user config class, not YAML sa-token alone): TYPE=user; tokenName=market-shop-user-token; timeout=2592000s (30d); activeTimeout=7200s (2h); isConcurrent=false; isShare=false; isReadBody=false; isReadHeader=false; isReadCookie=true; isWriteHeader=false; tokenStyle=tik; cookie path=/, httpOnly=true, secure from market-shop.security.secure-cookie, sameSite=Lax.
YAML sa-token.* (token-name market-shop-token etc.) is framework default; user sessions use StpUserKit overrides.
SaTokenSecurityConfiguration excludes /api/v1/auth/wechat/** and /api/v1/auth/dev-login from member SaInterceptor.

Identity tables: iam_user_account (incl. auth_epoch from V11); iam_external_identity(provider,app_id,open_id,union_id) unique(provider,app_id,open_id); iam_union_principal(union_id unique); customer_invitation_code; customer_relation; iam_bootstrap_sponsor_claim.

Invite enforcement: MyBatisIdentityAdapter.findOrRegister — existing external or union login skips invite; new user requires non-blank inviteCode else INVITE_CODE_REQUIRED; validates ACTIVE/not expired/not exhausted; then creates user+external+union+profile+relation+basic membership+ledger+increment invitation.
Sponsor claim path: sponsorClaimSecretHash non-null → only providers WECHAT_H5|WECHAT_WEB; no invite; CAS claim on iam_bootstrap_sponsor_claim.

market-shop.wechat keys (bound via @Value, not a dedicated market-shop.wechat @ConfigurationProperties): enabled, mock-enabled, official-account-app-id, official-account-secret, website-app-id, website-secret, oauth-callback-base-url, storefront-base-url.

ProductionRuntimeProperties @ConfigurationProperties("market-shop.production") nested Wechat{enabled,mockEnabled,officialAccountAppId,officialAccountSecret,websiteAppId,websiteSecret,callbackBaseUrl,storefrontBaseUrl} validates when enabled.
No code2session / miniprogram keys / WECHAT_MP provider anywhere yet.

WeChat-related tests: AuthApplicationServiceTest, WeChatOAuthAdapterTest, MyBatisIdentityAdapterTest, AuthControllerRedirectTest, LoginResponseContractTest, SaTokenSecurityConfigurationTest, SaTokenSessionControlAdapterTest, ProductionRuntimePropertiesTest, ProductionEnvironmentPostProcessorTest, SystemControllerTest, BootstrapIdentityInitializerTest.
risks: Cookie-only Sa-Token (isReadHeader=false) + LoginResponseContractTest forbidding token in SessionView: mini programs often cannot rely on browser cookies the same way as H5; may need header/token transport policy change.
code2session does not return nickname/avatar; existing registration defaults nickname to 微信用户 when blank — acceptable, but profile enrichment is separate.
Provider string must be new (e.g. WECHAT_MP) with miniprogram appId; union_id can still merge users via iam_union_principal if open platforms share union.
SPONSOR_CLAIM_PROVIDERS excludes non-H5/WEB; miniprogram cannot claim bootstrap sponsor without extending that set.
Production validation currently requires OA+website secrets when wechat.enabled; miniprogram-only deploy may need validation rule updates.
OAuth browser-binding cookie path is /api/v1/auth/wechat — irrelevant for miniprogram if state is skipped, but any accidental reuse of complete/callback would still require cookie.
